kairos-hermes-2-oak-ridge-tn-64590a39.name: Kairos Power Hermes 2
kairos-hermes-2-oak-ridge-tn-64590a39.notes: First deployment under the October 2024 Kairos Power-Google Master Plant Development Agreement (Google fleet-wide target of up to 500 MW across multiple Kairos plants by 2035). Power is delivered via a Tennessee Valley Authority PPA (announced 2025-08-18) -- the first US utility PPA for an advanced Gen IV reactor -- intended to serve Google data centers in Montgomery County, TN and Jackson County, AL (grid-region delivery, no single named campus). Shares the Heritage Center/ETTP campus with the earlier, smaller non-power-producing Hermes 1 demonstration reactor but sits on a distinct K-33 parcel. Target operation by 2030.
